settings.default: How to Care for Your Aurca

settings.label: Answer
settings.default:
A little care goes a long way in keeping your homewear soft, comfortable, and looking its best.

  • Machine wash at 30°C on a gentle cycle.
  • Wash inside out with similar colours.
  • Use mild detergent and avoid bleach.
  • Air dry whenever possible to help preserve the fabric’s softness, colour, and shape.
  • Avoid high heat when drying to reduce the risk of shrinkage.
  • Iron inside out on a low to medium setting if needed.

Returns & Refunds

You can return your order within 14 days of delivery, provided that:
